contest.measure_text: With funds that cannot be taken by the State and spent elsewhere, shall Bellflower Unified School District's measure to repair/replace deteriorating roofs, plumbing, heating, ventilation and electrical systems; upgrade classrooms, labs and career training facilities; and, improve access for students with disabilities be adopted, authorizing $135 million in bonds levying $49 per $100,000 assessed value ($8 million annually) while outstanding, with legal rates, audits, citizen oversight, no funds for administrator salaries and full disclosure of all spending? Supporters: Asm. José Solache; Sup. Janice Hahn; Dr. Robinson, BUSD Teacher; John Young, BTA Pres.; Mayra Garza, BUSD School Board Pres. Opponents: None submitted.
contest.office: BELLFLOWER UNIFIED SCHOOL DISTRICT SPECIAL ELECTION - MEASURE SM
